case: Quoted mixed-case schema and enum identifiers through metadata, edit, draft insert and typed filter consumers
contract: Catalog metadata resolves a schema and enum type whose quoted names contain spaces and embedded double quotes.
Schema-aware keyed edit and draft insert generate correctly quoted type casts and preserve an empty enum label, Unicode label, literal NULL label and SQL NULL distinctly.
A typed equality filter returns only the native enum literal-NULL row.
PostgreSQL catalog joins verify the exact stored schema/type/value, row identity and untouched sibling values after writes.

native_contract.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-postgres --test integration value_contract_quoted_enum_identifiers_preserve_metadata_and_typed_writes -- --include-ignored --nocapture --test-threads=1

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-postgres --all-targets -- -D warnings

remaining: Other enum consumer/session configurations and the broader B3 engine/type matrix remain open.
